title: eat shit & die 162
author: bpatrick
hoverText: you can tell it's hell because there's no smoking
body: Holy shit! A comic start to finish in one day. I don’t know if I’ve ever done that. I had a Curious Urgency half done but decided it’s been forever since we had a color eat shit & die. So here it is. I kinda like it.

comments.author: Jamie
comments.text:
Dude, nice one. Been keeping an eye out for updates the last few months.
The erratic uploads kinda adds to it, but i haven’t been disappointed yet. Keep em coming, cheers.

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text:
Start to finish in one day?? Nice.

What’s the inspiration behind the Hell guy? I love the design.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text:
@ Jamie: Thanks! I’m glad the lame updating schedule hasn’t ruined it for you. I’m always hopeful it will get better.
@ Winston Rowntree: Thanks, I’ve never done one in a day before. Probably never will again. That’s just what I have always thought of Satan looking like. It comes from my childhood somewhere. I thought he turned out alright. Now I’m thinking the colors of his robes should be reversed though.

comments.author: The_GeoCur
comments.text: Hey, I’m loving the Caligula-esque look to Satan! Good comparison!

comments.author: T52
comments.text: Hehe, I just noticed Trent’s “Nine Inch Nails” tattoo. It makes me wonder if Trent is his real name, or if people just call him that because he listens to them a lot/ looks sort of like Trent Reznor.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: You’re the first one to notice, T52. You can kind of see it in a few other comics.

comments.author: Joe bob
comments.text: Wow that takes me back I used to have bad nightmares when I would drink …

comments.author: Sydney
comments.text: The Inspiration is nny Judging trents tattoo in the last frame. And the ‘not good enough for hell’ bit.

comments.author: Sydney
comments.text: NIN on the tattoo. Not as cool.
